name: Creative Practice
what_you_do: Help teaching artists run weekend art classes for students of all ages. You prepare studios and materials, learn lesson planning, and make your own art with other teens.
who_can_apply: New York City teens who are in 10th, 11th, or 12th grade when it starts.
pay_detail: $17 per hour, up to 120 hours for the year. MetroCards for weekend work.
duration: September 2026 to June 2027: some Thursdays 4:30 to 6:30 PM, plus a weekly three-hour weekend art class each semester.
deadline_text: The 2026 to 2027 deadline has passed. The page says to come back in June 2027 to apply for the fall 2027 program.
how_to_apply: Online application through the link on the program page when it is open.
notes: The museum says this is best for teens who have no other clubs or jobs. Questions: teen.programs@brooklynmuseum.org.
